    pg_loss = agg_loss(
        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
    )
    return pg_loss, {}


@register_policy_loss("clip_cov")
def compute_policy_loss_clip_cov(
    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    advantages: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for Clip-Cov.

    Adapted from
    https://github.com/PRIME-RL/Entropy-Mechanism-of-RL/blob/main/verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py

    Args:
        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        advantages (torch.Tensor):
            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        cliprange (float, optional):
            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
            Defaults to None (must be provided).
        cliprange_low (float, optional):
            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
        cliprange_high (float, optional):
            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
        clip_cov_ratio (float, optional):
            Ratio for clipping the covariance. Defaults to 0.0002.
        clip_cov_lb (float, optional):
            Lower bound for clipping covariance. Defaults to 1.0.
        clip_cov_ub (float, optional):
            Upper bound for clipping covariance. Defaults to 5.0.
    """
    assert config is not None
    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig), "passing AlgoConfig not supported yet"
    assert config.policy_loss is not None

    clip_cov_ratio = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ratio if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ratio is not None else 0.0002
    cliprange = config.clip_ratio
    cliprange_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else cliprange
    cliprange_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else cliprange
    clip_cov_ub = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ub if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ub is not None else 5.0
    clip_cov_lb = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_lb if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_lb is not None else 1.0

    assert clip_cov_ratio > 0, "clip_ratio should be larger than 0."

    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)

    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio

    if cliprange_low is None:
        cliprange_low = cliprange
    if cliprange_high is None:
        cliprange_high = cliprange

    corr = torch.ones_like(advantages)
    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high)
    clip_by_origin = (pg_losses2 > pg_losses1) & (response_mask > 0)

    cov_all = (advantages - verl_F.masked_mean(advantages, response_mask)) * (
        log_prob - verl_F.masked_mean(log_prob.detach(), response_mask)
    )
    cov_all[response_mask == 0] = -torch.inf
    cov_all[clip_by_origin] = -torch.inf

    clip_num = max(int(clip_cov_ratio * response_mask.sum().item()), 1)
    top_k_idx = (cov_all < clip_cov_ub) & (cov_all > clip_cov_lb) & (response_mask > 0)
    top_k_idx = torch.nonzero(top_k_idx)

    if len(top_k_idx) > 0:
        perm = torch.randperm(len(top_k_idx))
        top_k_idx = top_k_idx[perm[: min(clip_num, len(top_k_idx))]]
    else:
        top_k_idx = torch.empty((0, 2), device=cov_all.device, dtype=torch.long)

    corr[top_k_idx[:, 0], top_k_idx[:, 1]] = 0

    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((corr == 0).float(), response_mask)

    pg_losses = torch.maximum(pg_losses1, pg_losses2) * corr

    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights

    pg_loss = agg_loss(
        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
    )
    pg_metrics = {
        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
    }
    return pg_loss, pg_metrics


@register_policy_loss("kl_cov")
def compute_policy_loss_kl_cov(
    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    advantages: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for Clip-Cov.

    Adapted from
    https://github.com/PRIME-RL/Entropy-Mechanism-of-RL/blob/main/verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py

    Args:
        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        advantages (torch.Tensor):
            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
        kl_cov_ratio (float, optional):
            Ratio for selecting the top-k covariance values. Defaults to 0.0002.
        ppo_kl_coef (float, optional):
            Coefficient for the KL penalty term in the loss. Defaults to 1.
    """
    assert config is not None
    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig), "passing AlgoConfig not supported yet"
    assert config.policy_loss is not None

    kl_cov_ratio = config.policy_loss.kl_cov_ratio if config.policy_loss.kl_cov_ratio is not None else 0.0002
    ppo_kl_coef = config.policy_loss.ppo_kl_coef if config.policy_loss.ppo_kl_coef is not None else 1.0

    assert kl_cov_ratio > 0, "kl_cov_ratio should be larger than 0."

    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
    abs_kl = negative_approx_kl.abs()
    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
    ppo_kl_abs = verl_F.masked_mean(negative_approx_kl.abs(), response_mask)
    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
    pg_losses_kl = -advantages * ratio + ppo_kl_coef * abs_kl
    pg_losses = pg_losses1

    all_valid = response_mask > 0
    all_valid_idx = torch.nonzero(all_valid.reshape(-1), as_tuple=True)[0]
    all_valid_adv = advantages[all_valid].detach().reshape(-1).cpu()
    all_valid_logp = log_prob[all_valid].detach().reshape(-1).cpu()

    k = min(kl_cov_ratio, len(all_valid_adv))

    if k != 0:
        cov_lst_all = (all_valid_adv - all_valid_adv.mean()) * (all_valid_logp - all_valid_logp.mean())
        k_percent_nums = max(1, int(len(cov_lst_all) * kl_cov_ratio))
        large_cov_idxs = torch.topk(cov_lst_all, k_percent_nums, largest=True).indices

        if len(large_cov_idxs) != 0:
            large_cov_idxs = all_valid_idx[large_cov_idxs]
            pg_losses[large_cov_idxs // advantages.shape[1], large_cov_idxs % advantages.shape[1]] = pg_losses_kl[
                large_cov_idxs // advantages.shape[1], large_cov_idxs % advantages.shape[1]
            ]

    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights

    pg_loss = agg_loss(
        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
    )
    pg_metrics = {
        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl_abs.detach().item(),
    }
    return pg_loss, pg_metrics


@register_policy_loss("geo_mean")
def compute_policy_loss_geo_mean(
    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    advantages: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for GMPO.

    Adapted from paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.20673
    https://github.com/callsys/GMPO/blob/main/train_zero_math_gmpo.py

    Args:
        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        advantages (torch.Tensor):
            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
            not used
    """

    assert config is not None
    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
    clip_ratio = config.clip_ratio  # Clipping parameter. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_ratio
    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_ratio

    cliprange = clip_ratio
    cliprange_low = clip_ratio_low
    cliprange_high = clip_ratio_high
    if cliprange_low is None:
        cliprange_low = cliprange
    if cliprange_high is None:
        cliprange_high = cliprange

    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability (uncomment it if you like)
    # negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)

    # Clipping at token-level & Clipping wider
    sgn_advantage = torch.sign(advantages)
    negative_approx_kl_clamp = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, -cliprange_low, cliprange_high)
    negative_approx_kl_min = torch.min(sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl, sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl_clamp)
    negative_approx_kl_min = sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl_min

    # Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization
    response_mask_sum = response_mask.sum(dim=-1)
    ratio = torch.exp((negative_approx_kl_min * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8))
    # we only support sequence level advantage for now,
    # otherwise, below would be not consistent with the paper
    advantage = (advantages * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8)
    pg_losses = -advantage * ratio

    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
    # For geo_mean, IS weights are 2D (batch_size, seq_length) and need to be aggregated to sequence level
    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
        # Aggregate token-level weights to sequence level using geometric mean for consistency
        # Note: rollout_is_weights is always 2D regardless of aggregation mode
        seq_is_weights = torch.exp(
            (torch.log(rollout_is_weights + 1e-10) * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8)
        )
        pg_losses = pg_losses * seq_is_weights

    pg_loss = torch.mean(pg_losses)

    # higher: ratio is too large that need clamp to clip_high (when adv > 0)
    clipped = torch.ne(negative_approx_kl, negative_approx_kl_clamp)
    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((clipped * (advantages > 0)).float(), response_mask)
    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((clipped * (advantages < 0)).float(), response_mask)
    pg_metrics = {
        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
    }
    return pg_loss, pg_metrics


@register_policy_loss("cispo")
def compute_policy_loss_cispo(
    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
    advantages: torch.Tensor,
    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
    config: Optional[DictConfig | ActorConfig] = None,
    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
    """
    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for CISPO.

    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.13585 for more details.
    """

    assert config is not None
    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else config.clip_ratio
    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else config.clip_ratio

    # Compute importance sampling ratio: π_θ / π_θ_old
    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
    # Clamp for numerical stability
    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)

    # CISPO: Clip the importance sampling weights
    # KEY: Apply stop gradient to the clipped ratio
    # This prevents gradients from flowing through the ratio computation and clipping
    # Gradients only flow through log_prob in the final loss term
    clipped_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - clip_ratio_low, 1 + clip_ratio_high)
    clipped_ratio_sg = clipped_ratio.detach()

    # CISPO objective function (to maximize): J = sg(clip(ratio)) * A * log π_θ
    # Loss function (to minimize): L = -J = -sg(clip(ratio)) * A * log_prob
    pg_losses = -clipped_ratio_sg * advantages * log_prob

    # Track clipping statistics
    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((ratio != clipped_ratio).float(), response_mask)

    # Apply rollout importance sampling weights if provided
    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights

    pg_loss = agg_loss(
        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
    )

    # For compatibility, return zero for pg_clipfrac_lower (not used in CISPO)
    pg_clipfrac_lower = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)

    pg_metrics = {
        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
    }
    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

153	class AdaptiveKLController:
154	    """
155	    Adaptive KL controller described in the paper:
156	    https://arxiv.org/pdf/1909.08593.pdf
157	    """
158	
159	    def __init__(self, init_kl_coef, target_kl, horizon):
160	        self.value = init_kl_coef
161	        self.target = target_kl
162	        self.horizon = horizon
163	
164	    def update(self, current_kl, n_steps):
165	        """Update the KL coefficient based on current KL divergence.
166	
167	        Args:
168	            current_kl (float): Current KL divergence value.
169	            n_steps (int): Number of steps taken.
170	        """
171	        target = self.target
172	        proportional_error = np.clip(current_kl / target - 1, -0.2, 0.2)
173	        mult = 1 + proportional_error * n_steps / self.horizon
174	        self.value *= mult
175

185

188	            n_steps (int): Number of steps taken (unused).

215	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GAE)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gae")
216	def compute_gae_advantage_return(
217	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
218	    values: torch.Tensor,
219	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
220	    gamma: torch.Tensor,
221	    lam: torch.Tensor,
222	):
223	    """Adapted from https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py
224	
225	    Args:
226	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
227	            shape is (bs, response_length)
228	        values: `(torch.Tensor)`
229	            shape is (bs, response_length)
230	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
231	            shape is (bs, response_length). [EOS] mask. The token after [EOS] have mask zero.
232	        gamma is `(float)`
233	            discounted factor used in RL
234	        lam: `(float)`
235	            lambda value when computing Generalized Advantage Estimation (https://arxiv.org/abs/1506.02438)
236	
237	    Returns:
238	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
239	            shape: (bs, response_length)
240	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
241	            shape: (bs, response_length)
242	
243	    """
244	    with torch.no_grad():
245	        nextvalues = 0
246	        lastgaelam = 0
247	        advantages_reversed = []
248	        gen_len = token_level_rewards.shape[-1]
249	
250	        for t in reversed(range(gen_len)):
251	            delta = token_level_rewards[:, t] + gamma * nextvalues - values[:, t]
252	            lastgaelam_ = delta + gamma * lam * lastgaelam
253	
254	            # skip values and TD-error on observation tokens
255	            nextvalues = values[:, t] * response_mask[:, t] + (1 - response_mask[:, t]) * nextvalues
256	            lastgaelam = lastgaelam_ * response_mask[:, t] + (1 - response_mask[:, t]) * lastgaelam
257	
258	            advantages_reversed.append(lastgaelam)
259	        advantages = torch.stack(advantages_reversed[::-1], dim=1)
260	
261	        returns = advantages + values
262	        advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(advantages, response_mask)
263	    return advantages, returns
264

267	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("grpo")
268	def compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
269	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
270	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
271	    index: np.ndarray,
272	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
273	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
274	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
275	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
276	    """
277	    Compute advantage for GRPO, operating only on Outcome reward
278	    (with only one scalar reward for each response).
279	
280	    Args:
281	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
282	            shape is (bs, response_length)
283	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
284	            shape is (bs, response_length)
285	        index: `(np.ndarray)`
286	            index array for grouping
287	        epsilon: `(float)`
288	            small value to avoid division by zero
289	        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: `(bool)`
290	            whether to scale the GRPO advantage
291	        config: `(Optional[AlgoConfig])`
292	            algorithm configuration object
293	
294	    Note:
295	        If norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo is True, the advantage is scaled by the std, as in the original GRPO.
296	        If False, the advantage is not scaled, as in Dr.GRPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.20783).
297	
298	    Returns:
299	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
300	            shape is (bs, response_length)
301	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
302	            shape is (bs, response_length)
303	    """
304	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
305	
306	    id2score = defaultdict(list)
307	    id2mean = {}
308	    id2std = {}
309	
310	    with torch.no_grad():
311	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
312	        for i in range(bsz):
313	            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
314	        for idx in id2score:
315	            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
316	                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
317	                id2std[idx] = torch.tensor(1.0)
318	            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
319	                scores_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
320	                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(scores_tensor)
321	                id2std[idx] = torch.std(scores_tensor)
322	            else:
323	                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
324	        for i in range(bsz):
325	            if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
326	                scores[i] = (scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]) / (id2std[index[i]] + epsilon)
327	            else:
328	                scores[i] = scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]
329	        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
330	
331	    return scores, scores
332

334	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO_VECTORIZED)
335	def compute_grpo_vectorized_outcome_advantage(
336	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
337	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
338	    index: np.ndarray,
339	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
340	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
341	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
342	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
343	    """
344	    Vectorized GRPO（outcome-only）:
345	      For each group g:
346	      a_i = \\frac{r_i - \\mu_g}{\\sigma_g} (or without dividing by \\sigma_g),
347	      then broadcast the scalar across the token dimension (multiplied by response_mask).。
348	    """
349	    with torch.no_grad():
350	        scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
351	        g = as_torch_index(index, device=scores.device)
352	        mean_g, std_g, _ = group_mean_std(scores, g, eps=0.0, device=scores.device)
353	        if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
354	            scalars = (scores - mean_g[g]) / (std_g[g] + epsilon)
355	        else:
356	            scalars = scores - mean_g[g]
357	        advantages = scalars.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
358	        return advantages, advantages

361	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GDPO)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("gdpo")
362	def compute_gdpo_outcome_advantage(
363	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
364	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
365	    index: np.ndarray,
366	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
367	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
368	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
369	    non_tensor_batch: Optional[dict] = None,
370	    batch: Optional[dict] = None,
371	    **kwargs,
372	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
373	    """
374	    GDPO: Group reward-Decoupled Normalization Policy Optimization.
375	
376	    Instead of summing all reward dimensions first (like GRPO), GDPO normalizes
377	    each reward dimension independently within each group before aggregation.
378	    This prevents a dominant reward signal from drowning out weaker ones.
379	
380	    Mathematical formulation:
381	        Step 1 – Group-wise decoupled normalization (via GRPO per dimension):
382	            For each reward dimension k, within each group g:
383	            A_k = (r_k - μ_group(r_k)) / (σ_group(r_k) + ε)
384	
385	        Step 2 – Weighted aggregation:
386	            A_sum = Σ_k w_k · A_k
387	
388	        Step 3 – Batch-level normalization (via masked_whiten):
389	            A_final = whiten(A_sum, response_mask)
390	
391	    Args:
392	        token_level_rewards: (bs, response_length) – standard token-level rewards.
393	            Used as fallback when per-dimension rewards are not provided.
394	        response_mask: (bs, response_length)
395	        index: (bs,) – group id per sample (from ``uid``).
396	        epsilon: Numerical stability constant.
397	        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: Whether to normalize by std in GRPO.
398	        config: Algorithm configuration (optional).
399	        non_tensor_batch: Non-tensor batch data containing per-dimension reward scores.
400	        batch: Batch data containing prompts, attention_mask, etc.
401	
402	    Note:
403	        Ref GDPO (https://arxiv.org/abs/2601.05242).
404	
405	    Returns:
406	        advantages: (bs, response_length)
407	        returns: (bs, response_length) – same as advantages (outcome-only).
408	    """
409	    score_list = None
410	    reward_weights = None
411	
412	    if config is not None and non_tensor_batch is not None and batch is not None:
413	        gdpo_reward_keys = config.get("gdpo_reward_keys", None)
414	        assert gdpo_reward_keys, (
415	            "GDPO requires 'algorithm.gdpo_reward_keys' listing the individual reward "
416	            "component keys returned by compute_score (e.g. ['format_reward', 'accuracy_reward'])."
417	        )
418	        device = token_level_rewards.device
419	        prompt_length = batch["prompts"].size(1)
420	        valid_response_length = batch["attention_mask"][:, prompt_length:].sum(dim=1) - 1
421	
422	        score_list = []
423	        for key in gdpo_reward_keys:
424	            assert key in non_tensor_batch, (
425	                f"GDPO reward key '{key}' not found in non_tensor_batch. "
426	                f"Available keys: {list(non_tensor_batch.keys())}. "
427	                f"Make sure your compute_score returns a dict containing '{key}'."
428	            )
429	            comp = non_tensor_batch[key]
430	            rm_score = torch.tensor(np.asarray(comp, dtype=np.float32), device=device)
431	            rm_scores = torch.zeros_like(response_mask, dtype=torch.float32)
432	            rm_scores[torch.arange(rm_scores.size(0), device=device), valid_response_length] = rm_score
433	            score_list.append(rm_scores)
434	
435	        gdpo_weights = config.get("gdpo_reward_weights", None)
436	        if gdpo_weights is not None:
437	            reward_weights = list(gdpo_weights)
438	
439	    if score_list is None:
440	        score_list = [token_level_rewards]
441	
442	    num_scores = len(score_list)
443	
444	    if reward_weights is not None:
445	        weights = torch.tensor(reward_weights, dtype=torch.float32, device=token_level_rewards.device)
446	    else:
447	        weights = torch.ones(num_scores, dtype=torch.float32, device=token_level_rewards.device)
448	
449	    new_advantage = None
450	
451	    for i in range(num_scores):
452	        normalized_score, _ = compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
453	            token_level_rewards=score_list[i],
454	            response_mask=response_mask,
455	            index=index,
456	            epsilon=epsilon,
457	            norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
458	            config=config,
459	        )
460	
461	        if new_advantage is None:
462	            new_advantage = weights[i] * normalized_score
463	        else:
464	            new_advantage += weights[i] * normalized_score
465	
466	    advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(new_advantage, response_mask) * response_mask
467	
468	    return advantages, advantages
469

471	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.GRPO_PASSK)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("grpo_passk")
472	def compute_grpo_passk_outcome_advantage(
473	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
474	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
475	    index: np.ndarray,
476	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
477	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
478	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
479	    **kwargs,
480	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
481	    """
482	    Compute advantage for Pass@k using a GRPO-style outcome reward formulation.
483	    Only the best response per group gets a non-zero advantage: r_max - r_second_max.
484	
485	    Implemented as described in https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.19595.
486	
487	    Args:
488	        token_level_rewards: (bs, response_length)
489	        response_mask: (bs, response_length)
490	        index: (bs,) → group ID per sample
491	        epsilon: float for numerical stability
492	        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm settings, which contains "norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo"
493	
494	    Returns:
495	        advantages: (bs, response_length)
496	        returns: (bs, response_length)
497	    """
498	    assert config is not None
499	    # if True, normalize advantage by std within group
500	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo = config.get("norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo", True)
501	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)  # (bs,)
502	    advantages = torch.zeros_like(scores)
503	
504	    id2scores = defaultdict(list)
505	    id2indices = defaultdict(list)
506	
507	    with torch.no_grad():
508	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
509	        for i in range(bsz):
510	            idx = index[i]
511	            id2scores[idx].append(scores[i])
512	            id2indices[idx].append(i)
513	
514	        for idx in id2scores:
515	            rewards = torch.stack(id2scores[idx])  # (k,)
516	            if rewards.numel() < 2:
517	                raise ValueError(
518	                    f"Pass@k requires at least 2 samples per group. Got {rewards.numel()} for group {idx}."
519	                )
520	            topk, topk_idx = torch.topk(rewards, 2)
521	            r_max, r_second_max = topk[0], topk[1]
522	            i_max = id2indices[idx][topk_idx[0].item()]
523	            advantage = r_max - r_second_max
524	            if norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo:
525	                std = torch.std(rewards)
526	                advantage = advantage / (std + epsilon)
527	            advantages[i_max] = advantage
528	
529	    advantages = advantages.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
530	    return advantages, advantages
531

588	def compute_rloo_outcome_advantage(

593	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
594	    **kwargs,
595	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
596	    """
597	    Compute advantage for RLOO based on https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14740
598	
599	    Args:
600	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
601	            shape: (bs, response_length)
602	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
603	            shape: (bs, response_length)
604	        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config
605	
606	    Returns:
607	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
608	            shape: (bs, response_length)
609	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
610	            shape: (bs, response_length)
611	    """
612	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
613	
614	    id2score = defaultdict(list)
615	    id2mean = {}
616	
617	    with torch.no_grad():
618	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
619	        for i in range(bsz):
620	            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
621	        for idx in id2score:
622	            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
623	                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
624	            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
625	                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(torch.stack(id2score[idx]))
626	            else:
627	                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
628	        for i in range(bsz):
629	            response_num = len(id2score[index[i]])
630	            if response_num > 1:
631	                scores[i] = scores[i] * response_num / (response_num - 1) - id2mean[index[i]] * response_num / (
632	                    response_num - 1
633	                )
634	        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
635	
636	    return scores, scores

654	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
655	            shape: (bs, response_length)
656	        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config
657	
658	    Returns:
659	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
660	            shape: (bs, response_length)
661	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
662	            shape: (bs, response_length)
663	    """
664	    response_length = response_mask.sum(dim=-1)
665	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
666	
667	    id2score = defaultdict(list)
668	    id2len = defaultdict(list)
669	    id2bsl = {}
670	
671	    with torch.no_grad():
672	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
673	        for i in range(bsz):
674	            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
675	            id2len[index[i]].append(response_length[i])
676	
677	        for idx in id2score:
678	            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
679	                id2bsl[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
680	            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
681	                score_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
682	                len_tensor = torch.stack(id2len[idx])
683	                id2bsl[idx] = (len_tensor * score_tensor).sum() / len_tensor.sum()
684	            else:
685	                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
686	        for i in range(bsz):
687	            scores[i] = scores[i] - id2bsl[index[i]]
688	        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask

690	    return scores, scores

697	    """
698	    Compute advantage for REINFORCE++.
699	    This implementation is based on the paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.03262
700	
701	    Args:
702	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`

705	            shape: (bs, response_length)

711	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
712	            shape: (bs, response_length)

714	    assert config is not None
715	    gamma = config.gamma
716	    with torch.no_grad():

718	        running_return = 0
719	
720	        for t in reversed(range(token_level_rewards.shape[1])):
721	            running_return = token_level_rewards[:, t] + gamma * running_return
722	            returns[:, t] = running_return
723	            # Reset after EOS
724	            running_return = running_return * response_mask[:, t]
725	
726	        advantages = verl_F.masked_whiten(returns, response_mask)
727	        advantages = advantages * response_mask

769	def compute_gpg_outcome_advantage(
770	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
771	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
772	    index: np.ndarray,
773	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
774	    f_norm: float = 1.0,
775	    alpha: float = 1.0,
776	    config=None,
777	    **kwargs,
778	):
779	    """
780	    Compute advantage for GPG, operating only on Outcome reward
781	    (with only one scalar reward for each response).
782	    Args:
783	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
784	            shape: (bs, response_length)
785	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
786	            shape: (bs, response_length)
787	        index: `(np.ndarray)`
788	            shape: (bs,)
789	        epsilon: (float)
790	        f_norm: (float)
791	        alpha: (float)
792	        config: (dict) algorithm config
793	
794	    Returns:
795	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
796	            shape: (bs, response_length)
797	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
798	            shape: (bs, response_length)
799	    """
800	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
801	
802	    id2score = defaultdict(list)
803	    id2mean = {}
804	    id2std = {}
805	
806	    with torch.no_grad():
807	        bsz = scores.shape[0]
808	        m = torch.count_nonzero(scores)
809	        alpha = bsz / m.clamp(min=1)
810	
811	        for i in range(bsz):
812	            id2score[index[i]].append(scores[i])
813	
814	        for idx in id2score:
815	            if len(id2score[idx]) == 1:
816	                id2mean[idx] = torch.tensor(0.0)
817	                id2std[idx] = torch.tensor(1.0)
818	            elif len(id2score[idx]) > 1:
819	                scores_tensor = torch.stack(id2score[idx])
820	                id2mean[idx] = torch.mean(scores_tensor)
821	                id2std[idx] = torch.std(scores_tensor)
822	            else:
823	                raise ValueError(f"no score in prompt index: {idx}")
824	        for i in range(bsz):
825	            scores[i] = alpha * (scores[i] - id2mean[index[i]]) / (f_norm)
826	        scores = scores.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
827	
828	    return scores, scores

831	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.RLOO_VECTORIZED)  # or simply: @register_adv_est("rloo_vectorized")
832	def compute_rloo_vectorized_outcome_advantage(
833	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
834	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
835	    index: np.ndarray,
836	    epsilon: float = 1e-6,
837	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
838	    **kwargs,
839	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
840	    """
841	    Compute advantage for RLOO based on https://arxiv.org/abs/2402.14740
842	
843	    Args:
844	        token_level_rewards: `(torch.Tensor)`
845	            shape: (bs, response_length)
846	        response_mask: `(torch.Tensor)`
847	            shape: (bs, response_length)
848	        config: (AlgoConfig) algorithm config
849	
850	    Returns:
851	        advantages: `(torch.Tensor)`
852	            shape: (bs, response_length)
853	        Returns: `(torch.Tensor)`
854	            shape: (bs, response_length)
855	    """
856	    scores = token_level_rewards.sum(dim=-1)
857	
858	    with torch.no_grad():
859	        inv = torch.from_numpy(np.unique(index, return_inverse=True)[1]).to(scores.device)
860	
861	        c = torch.bincount(inv)[inv].to(scores.dtype)
862	        adv = ((c * scores - torch.bincount(inv, weights=scores)[inv]) / (c - 1).clamp_min(1)) * (c > 1)
863	
864	        adv = adv.unsqueeze(-1) * response_mask
865	
866	    return adv, adv

869	@register_adv_est(AdvantageEstimator.OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE)
870	def compute_optimal_token_baseline_advantage(
871	    token_level_rewards: torch.Tensor,
872	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
873	    index: np.ndarray,
874	    old_log_probs: torch.Tensor,
875	    sum_pi_squared: torch.Tensor,
876	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor = None,
877	    handle_zero_tail: bool = True,
878	    epsilon: float = 1e-8,
879	    **kwargs,
880	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
881	    """
882	    Compute advantages using Optimal Token Baseline (OTB).
883	
884	    Unlike the group mean based baseline which uses a single baseline per trajectory,
885	    this computes a unique baseline for each timestep using cumulative path variance.
886	
887	    Theory:
888	        For each timestep t in each prompt group:
889	            B_t* = E[G_t × W_t] / E[W_t]
890	        where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path-variance proxy)
891	        and ||s_j||² = 1 - 2π_j + Σπ²
892	
893	    The cumulative sum W_t captures the "realized energy" of trajectory has been up to timestep t,
894	    giving higher weight to predicting rewards on high-variance paths.
895	
896	    Args:
897	        token_level_rewards: Rewards at each token position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
898	        response_mask: Binary mask for valid tokens (1) vs padding (0) [shape: (bs, response_length)]
899	        index: Prompt indices for grouping trajectories from same prompt [shape: (bs,)]
900	        old_log_probs: Log probabilities from training policy during generation [shape: (bs, response_length)]
901	        sum_pi_squared: Sum of squared probabilities over vocabulary Σπ² [shape: (bs, response_length)]
902	        rollout_is_weights: Pre-computed IS weights for W correction [shape: (bs, response_length)],
903	            None if not using IS
904	        handle_zero_tail: If True, zero baselines will be set in the portion of the longest trajectory
905	            that extends beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
906	            Default: True
907	        epsilon: Small constant for numerical stability (default: 1e-8)
908	
909	    Returns:
910	        advantages: OTB advantage estimates [shape: (bs, response_length)]
911	        returns: Cumulative rewards (returns) from each position [shape: (bs, response_length)]
912	
913	    Note on Rollout Importance Sampling:
914	        When rollout_is_weights is provided, W_t is scaled by ρ̄²(t) to minimize MSE under truncated IS:
915	            B_t* = Σ[G_t × ρ̄²(t) × W_t] / Σ[ρ̄²(t) × W_t]
916	    """
917	    with torch.no_grad():
918	        batch_size, seq_len = token_level_rewards.shape
919	        device = token_level_rewards.device
920	
921	        # Compute returns (reward-to-go) for each timestep
922	        returns = (token_level_rewards * response_mask).flip(dims=[-1]).cumsum(dim=-1).flip(dims=[-1])
923	
924	        # Step 1: Compute w_per_timestep = 1 - 2π_t + Σπ²)
925	        pi_t = torch.exp(old_log_probs)
926	        w_per_timestep = 1 - 2 * pi_t + sum_pi_squared
927	
928	        # Step 2: Apply rollout importance sampling correction (if enabled)
929	        if rollout_is_weights is not None:
930	            # Scale W by ρ̄² to minimize MSE under truncated IS
931	            w_per_timestep = w_per_timestep * (rollout_is_weights**2)
932	
933	        # Step 3: Compute cumulative path-variance proxy: W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t w_j
934	        # This measures accumulated variance from the start of the trajectory up to timestep t
935	        w_cumulative = (w_per_timestep * response_mask).cumsum(dim=-1)
936	
937	        # Group trajectories by prompt
938	        prompt_groups = defaultdict(list)
939	        for i in range(batch_size):
940	            prompt_groups[index[i]].append(i)
941	
942	        # Initialize baselines tensor [batch_size, seq_len]
943	        baselines = torch.zeros_like(returns)
944	
945	        # Compute per-step baseline for each prompt group
946	        for _, trajectory_indices in prompt_groups.items():
947	            N = len(trajectory_indices)
948	            if N == 1:
949	                # Single trajectory - no baseline (advantage = return)
950	                continue
951	
952	            traj_idx = torch.tensor(trajectory_indices, device=device)
953	
954	            # Extract group data [N, seq_len]
955	            returns_group = returns[traj_idx]
956	            w_cumulative_group = w_cumulative[traj_idx]
957	            mask_group = response_mask[traj_idx]
958	
959	            # Compute per-timestep baseline: B_t = Σ[G_t × W_t] / Σ[W_t]
960	            # where W_t = Σ_{j=1}^t ||s_j||² (cumulative path variance)
961	            # Shape: [seq_len]
962	            numerator = (returns_group * w_cumulative_group * mask_group).sum(dim=0)  # Sum over trajectories
963	            denominator = (w_cumulative_group * mask_group).sum(dim=0) + epsilon
964	
965	            baseline_per_step = numerator / denominator  # [seq_len]
966	
967	            # Assign to all trajectories in this group
968	            baselines[traj_idx] = baseline_per_step.unsqueeze(0).expand(N, -1)
969	
970	            if handle_zero_tail:
971	                # Optionally zero out the portion of the longest trajectory that extends
972	                # beyond the second-longest trajectory in the prompt group.
973	                response_lengths = mask_group.sum(dim=-1)
974	                sorted_lengths, _ = torch.sort(response_lengths)
975	                max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-1].item())
976	                second_max_length = int(sorted_lengths[-2].item())
977	                max_length_idx = (response_lengths == max_length).nonzero(as_tuple=True)[0]
978	                if max_length_idx.numel() == 1 and max_length > second_max_length:
979	                    max_length_traj_idx = trajectory_indices[int(max_length_idx[0])]
980	                    baselines[max_length_traj_idx, second_max_length:] = 0.0
981	
982	        # Compute advantages: A_t = G_t - B_t
983	        advantages = (returns - baselines) * response_mask
984	
985	    return advantages, returns
986

1035	    """

1038	        token_returns = (token_level_rewards * response_mask).flip(dims=[-1]).cumsum(dim=-1).flip(dims=[-1])
1039	
1040	        # Step 1: Compute w_per_timestep = 1 - 2π_t + Σπ²)
1041	        pi_t = torch.exp(old_log_probs)

1122	def compute_rewards(token_level_scores, old_log_prob, ref_log_prob, kl_ratio):
1123	    """Compute token-level rewards with KL penalty.
1124	
1125	    Args:
1126	        token_level_scores (torch.Tensor): Token-level reward scores.
1127	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor): Log probabilities from current policy.
1128	        ref_log_prob (torch.Tensor): Log probabilities from reference policy.
1129	        kl_ratio (float): KL penalty coefficient.
1130	
1131	    Returns:
1132	        torch.Tensor: Token-level rewards with KL penalty applied.
1133	    """
1134	    kl = old_log_prob - ref_log_prob
1135	    return token_level_scores - kl * kl_ratio

1154	    Args:

1156	        loss_mask: micro batch loss mask, (bs, response_length)

1173	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(loss_mat, loss_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
1174	    elif loss_agg_mode in ["seq-mean-token-sum", "seq-mean-token-sum-norm"]:
1175	        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1)  # token-sum
1176	        seq_mask = (torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1) > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
1177	        if global_batch_size is None:
1178	            if dp_size > 1:
1179	                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")
1180	            global_batch_size = seq_mask.sum()
1181	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean
1182	        if loss_agg_mode == "seq-mean-token-sum-norm":
1183	            if loss_scale_factor is None:
1184	                horizon = loss_mask.shape[-1]
1185	                loss_scale_factor = horizon
1186	            loss /= loss_scale_factor

1188	        seq_mask = torch.sum(loss_mask, dim=-1)  # per-sequence token count
1189	        seq_losses = torch.sum(loss_mat * loss_mask, dim=-1) / (seq_mask + 1e-8)  # token-mean
1190	        seq_mask = (seq_mask > 0).float()  # exclude fully masked sequences
1191	        if global_batch_size is None:
1192	            if dp_size > 1:
1193	                raise ValueError("global_batch_size is required when dp_size > 1")

1195	        loss = verl_F.masked_sum(seq_losses, seq_mask) / global_batch_size * dp_size  # seq-mean

1197	        raise ValueError(f"Invalid loss_agg_mode: {loss_agg_mode}")

1203	def compute_policy_loss(
1204	    old_log_prob,
1205	    log_prob,
1206	    advantages,
1207	    response_mask,
1208	    cliprange=None,
1209	    cliprange_low=None,
1210	    cliprange_high=None,
1211	    clip_ratio_c=3.0,
1212	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1213	):
1214	    """
1215	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for PPO.
1216	
1217	    Adapted from
1218	    https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/main/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L1122
1219	
1220	    Args:
1221	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1222	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1223	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1224	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1225	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1226	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1227	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1228	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1229	        cliprange (float, optional):
1230	            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1231	            Defaults to None (must be provided).
1232	        cliprange_low (float, optional):
1233	            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1234	        cliprange_high (float, optional):
1235	            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1236	        clip_ratio_c (float, optional):
1237	            Lower bound of the ratio for dual-clip PPO. See https://arxiv.org/pdf/1912.09729.
1238	            Defaults to 3.0.
1239	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1240	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1241	    """
1242	    assert clip_ratio_c > 1.0, (
1243	        "The lower bound of the clip_ratio_c for dual-clip PPO should be greater than 1.0,"
1244	        + f" but get the value: {clip_ratio_c}."
1245	    )
1246	
1247	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1248	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1249	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1250	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1251	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1252	
1253	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1254	    if cliprange_low is None:
1255	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1256	    if cliprange_high is None:
1257	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1258	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(
1259	        ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high
1260	    )  # - clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A
1261	    clip_pg_losses1 = torch.maximum(
1262	        pg_losses1, pg_losses2
1263	    )  # max(-ratio * A, -clip(ratio, 1-cliprange, 1+cliprange) * A)
1264	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean(torch.gt(pg_losses2, pg_losses1).float(), response_mask)
1265	
1266	    pg_losses3 = -advantages * clip_ratio_c
1267	    clip_pg_losses2 = torch.min(pg_losses3, clip_pg_losses1)
1268	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean(
1269	        torch.gt(clip_pg_losses1, pg_losses3) * (advantages < 0).float(), response_mask
1270	    )
1271	
1272	    pg_losses = torch.where(advantages < 0, clip_pg_losses2, clip_pg_losses1)
1273	    pg_loss = agg_loss(loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode)
1274	
1275	    return pg_loss, pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower

1373	def compute_policy_loss_dppo_tv(
1374	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1375	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1376	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1377	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1378	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1379	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1380	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1381	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1382	    """
1383	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for DPPO-Binary-TV.
1384	
1385	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1386	
1387	    Args:
1388	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1389	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1390	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1391	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1392	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1393	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1394	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1395	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1396	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1397	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1398	        config: `(verl.trainer.config.ActorConfig)`:
1399	            config for the actor.
1400	        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:
1401	            log probabilities of actions under the rollout policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1402	    """
1403	
1404	    assert config is not None
1405	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1406	    # Note: the clip_ratio is different from the standard PPO, it is the TV divergence threshold for DPPO.
1407	    clip_divergence = config.clip_ratio
1408	    clip_divergence_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_divergence
1409	    clip_divergence_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_divergence
1410	
1411	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1412	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1413	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1414	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1415	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1416	
1417	    # Instead of dual-clip PPO, we use truncated importance sampling (TIS) to clip the policy loss.
1418	    # However, a large threshold is recommended to avoid performance degradation due to the truncation bias.
1419	    # See Section 5.4 in https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1420	    clip_ratio_c = config.get("clip_ratio_c", 20.0)
1421	    truncated_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, max=clip_ratio_c)
1422	    truncated_ratio = truncated_ratio.detach()

1425	    prob = torch.exp(log_prob)
1426	    old_prob = torch.exp(old_log_prob)
1427	    valid_positive_mask = (prob - old_prob) <= clip_divergence_high
1428	    valid_negative_mask = (prob - old_prob) >= -clip_divergence_low
1429	    valid_mask = torch.where(advantages > 0, valid_positive_mask, valid_negative_mask)
1430	    valid_mask = valid_mask.detach().float()
1431	
1432	    pg_losses = -advantages * truncated_ratio * log_prob * valid_mask
1433	
1434	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1435	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1436	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1437	
1438	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1439	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1440	    )

1442	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((1.0 - valid_mask).float(), response_mask)
1443	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((ratio > clip_ratio_c).float() * valid_mask, response_mask)
1444	
1445	    pg_metrics = {
1446	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1447	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1448	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1449	    }
1450	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1455	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1456	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1457	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1458	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1459	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1460	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1461	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1462	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1463	    """
1464	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for DPPO-Binary-KL.
1465	
1466	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1467	
1468	    Args:
1469	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1470	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1471	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1472	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1473	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1474	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1475	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1476	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1477	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1478	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1479	        config: `(verl.trainer.config.ActorConfig)`:
1480	            config for the actor.
1481	        rollout_log_probs: `(torch.Tensor)`:
1482	            log probabilities of actions under the rollout policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1483	    """
1484	
1485	    assert config is not None
1486	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1487	    # Note: the clip_ratio is different from the standard PPO, it is the KL divergence threshold for DPPO.
1488	    clip_divergence = config.clip_ratio
1489	    clip_divergence_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_divergence
1490	    clip_divergence_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_divergence
1491	
1492	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1493	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1494	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1495	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1496	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1497	
1498	    # Instead of dual-clip PPO, we use truncated importance sampling (TIS) to clip the policy loss.
1499	    # However, a large threshold is recommended to avoid performance degradation due to the truncation bias.
1500	    # See Section 5.4 in https://arxiv.org/pdf/2602.04879 for more details.
1501	    clip_ratio_c = config.get("clip_ratio_c", 20.0)
1502	    truncated_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, max=clip_ratio_c)
1503	    truncated_ratio = truncated_ratio.detach()
1504	
1505	    # Compute valid mask for DPPO-Binary-KL
1506	    prob = torch.exp(log_prob)
1507	    old_prob = torch.exp(old_log_prob)
1508	    binary_kl = old_prob * (old_log_prob - log_prob) + (1 - old_prob) * torch.log(
1509	        (1.0 - old_prob + 1e-8) / (1.0 - prob + 1e-8)

1512	    valid_negative_mask = (binary_kl <= clip_divergence_low) | (prob >= old_prob)

1514	    valid_mask = valid_mask.detach().float()
1515	
1516	    pg_losses = -advantages * truncated_ratio * log_prob * valid_mask
1517

1519	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1520	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights

1524	    )

1527	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((1.0 - valid_mask).float(), response_mask)
1528	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((ratio > clip_ratio_c).float() * valid_mask, response_mask)
1529	
1530	    pg_metrics = {
1531	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1532	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1533	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1534	    }
1535	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1538	@register_policy_loss("gspo")
1539	def compute_policy_loss_gspo(
1540	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1541	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1542	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1543	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1544	    loss_agg_mode: str = "seq-mean-token-mean",
1545	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1546	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1547	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1548	    """
1549	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for GSPO.
1550	
1551	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2507.18071 for more details.
1552	
1553	    Args:
1554	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1555	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1556	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1557	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1558	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1559	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1560	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1561	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1562	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1563	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. For GSPO, it is recommended to use "seq-mean-token-mean".
1564	    """
1565	
1566	    assert config is not None
1567	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
1568	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else config.clip_ratio
1569	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else config.clip_ratio
1570	
1571	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1572	
1573	    # compute sequence-level importance ratio:
1574	    # si(θ) = (π_θ(yi|x)/π_θold(yi|x))^(1/|yi|) =
1575	    # exp [(1/|y_i|) * Σ_t log(π_θ(y_i,t|x,y_i,<t)/π_θold(y_i,t|x,y_i,<t))]
1576	    seq_lengths = torch.sum(response_mask, dim=-1).clamp(min=1)
1577	    negative_approx_kl_seq = torch.sum(negative_approx_kl * response_mask, dim=-1) / seq_lengths
1578	
1579	    # Combined ratio at token level:
1580	    # s_i,t(θ) = sg[s_i(θ)] · π_θ(y_i,t|x, y_i,<t) / sg[π_θ(y_i,t|x, y_i,<t)]
1581	    # In log space: log(s_i,t(θ)) = sg[log(s_i(θ))] + log_prob - sg[log_prob]
1582	    log_seq_importance_ratio = log_prob - log_prob.detach() + negative_approx_kl_seq.detach().unsqueeze(-1)
1583	    log_seq_importance_ratio = torch.clamp(log_seq_importance_ratio, max=10.0)  # clamp for numerical stability
1584	
1585	    # finaly exp() to remove log
1586	    seq_importance_ratio = torch.exp(log_seq_importance_ratio)
1587	
1588	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * seq_importance_ratio

1614	@register_policy_loss("sapo")
1615	def compute_policy_loss_sapo(
1616	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1617	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1618	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1619	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1620	    loss_agg_mode: str = "seq-mean-token-mean",
1621	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1622	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1623	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1624	    """
1625	    Compute the smoothed policy objective and related metrics for SAPO.
1626	
1627	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2511.20347 for more details.
1628	
1629	    Args:
1630	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1631	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1632	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1633	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1634	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1635	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1636	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1637	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1638	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1639	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. For SAPO, it is recommended to use "seq-mean-token-mean".
1640	    """
1641	
1642	    assert config is not None
1643	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
1644	
1645	    # temperature for positive and negative token updates
1646	    tau_pos = torch.as_tensor(config.tau_pos, dtype=advantages.dtype, device=advantages.device)
1647	    tau_neg = torch.as_tensor(config.tau_neg, dtype=advantages.dtype, device=advantages.device)
1648	
1649	    def gate_function(x, tau):
1650	        """The gating function used in SAPO"""
1651	        return torch.sigmoid(tau * (x - 1.0)) * (4.0 / tau)
1652	
1653	    # compute IS at token level:
1654	    # r_{i,t}(θ) = π_θ(y_{i,t}|x, y_{i,<t}) / π_θold(y_{i,t}|x, y_{i,<t})]
1655	    # In log space: log(r_{i,t}(θ)) = log_prob - ol_log_prob
1656	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1657	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability
1658	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1659	    # finally exp() to remove log and get r_{i,t}(θ)
1660	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1661	
1662	    # tau_{i,t} is tau_pos if adv > 0 else tau_neg
1663	    taus = torch.where(
1664	        condition=advantages > 0,
1665	        input=tau_pos,  # if A_{i,t} > 0 we set to tau_pos
1666	        other=tau_neg,  # if A_{i,t} <= 0 we set to tau_neg
1667	    )
1668	
1669	    # compute the gates f_{i,t}(r_{i,t}(θ)) at token level
1670	    gates = gate_function(ratio, taus)
1671	
1672	    # compute policy gradient loss
1673	    pg_losses = -gates * advantages
1674	
1675	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1676	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1677	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1678	
1679	    # for SAPO, we need to aggregate the loss at the sequence level (seq-mean-token-mean)
1680	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1681	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode="seq-mean-token-mean", **config.global_batch_info
1682	    )
1683	
1684	    # For compatibility, return zero for both pg_clipfrac and pg_clipfrac_lower (not used in SAPO)
1685	    pg_clipfrac = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)
1686	    pg_clipfrac_lower = torch.tensor(0.0, device=pg_loss.device)
1687	    # compute KL for metrics tracking
1688	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1689	    # return metrics dict
1690	    pg_metrics = {
1691	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1692	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1693	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
1694	    }
1695	
1696	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1735	@register_policy_loss("clip_cov")
1736	def compute_policy_loss_clip_cov(
1737	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1738	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1739	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1740	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1741	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1742	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1743	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1744	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1745	    """
1746	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for Clip-Cov.
1747	
1748	    Adapted from
1749	    https://github.com/PRIME-RL/Entropy-Mechanism-of-RL/blob/main/verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py
1750	
1751	    Args:
1752	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1753	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1754	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1755	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1756	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1757	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1758	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1759	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1760	        cliprange (float, optional):
1761	            Clipping parameter ε for standard PPO. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1762	            Defaults to None (must be provided).
1763	        cliprange_low (float, optional):
1764	            Lower clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1765	        cliprange_high (float, optional):
1766	            Upper clip range for dual-clip PPO. Defaults to same as `cliprange`.
1767	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1768	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1769	        clip_cov_ratio (float, optional):
1770	            Ratio for clipping the covariance. Defaults to 0.0002.
1771	        clip_cov_lb (float, optional):
1772	            Lower bound for clipping covariance. Defaults to 1.0.
1773	        clip_cov_ub (float, optional):
1774	            Upper bound for clipping covariance. Defaults to 5.0.
1775	    """
1776	    assert config is not None
1777	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig), "passing AlgoConfig not supported yet"
1778	    assert config.policy_loss is not None
1779	
1780	    clip_cov_ratio = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ratio if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ratio is not None else 0.0002
1781	    cliprange = config.clip_ratio
1782	    cliprange_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else cliprange
1783	    cliprange_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else cliprange
1784	    clip_cov_ub = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ub if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_ub is not None else 5.0
1785	    clip_cov_lb = config.policy_loss.clip_cov_lb if config.policy_loss.clip_cov_lb is not None else 1.0
1786	
1787	    assert clip_cov_ratio > 0, "clip_ratio should be larger than 0."
1788	
1789	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1790	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1791	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1792	
1793	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1794	
1795	    if cliprange_low is None:
1796	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1797	    if cliprange_high is None:
1798	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1799	
1800	    corr = torch.ones_like(advantages)
1801	    pg_losses2 = -advantages * torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - cliprange_low, 1 + cliprange_high)
1802	    clip_by_origin = (pg_losses2 > pg_losses1) & (response_mask > 0)
1803	
1804	    cov_all = (advantages - verl_F.masked_mean(advantages, response_mask)) * (
1805	        log_prob - verl_F.masked_mean(log_prob.detach(), response_mask)
1806	    )
1807	    cov_all[response_mask == 0] = -torch.inf
1808	    cov_all[clip_by_origin] = -torch.inf
1809	
1810	    clip_num = max(int(clip_cov_ratio * response_mask.sum().item()), 1)
1811	    top_k_idx = (cov_all < clip_cov_ub) & (cov_all > clip_cov_lb) & (response_mask > 0)
1812	    top_k_idx = torch.nonzero(top_k_idx)
1813	
1814	    if len(top_k_idx) > 0:
1815	        perm = torch.randperm(len(top_k_idx))
1816	        top_k_idx = top_k_idx[perm[: min(clip_num, len(top_k_idx))]]
1817	    else:
1818	        top_k_idx = torch.empty((0, 2), device=cov_all.device, dtype=torch.long)
1819	
1820	    corr[top_k_idx[:, 0], top_k_idx[:, 1]] = 0
1821	
1822	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((corr == 0).float(), response_mask)
1823	
1824	    pg_losses = torch.maximum(pg_losses1, pg_losses2) * corr
1825	
1826	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1827	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1828	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1829	
1830	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1831	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1832	    )
1833	    pg_metrics = {
1834	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
1835	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
1836	    }
1837	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics

1840	@register_policy_loss("kl_cov")
1841	def compute_policy_loss_kl_cov(
1842	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1843	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1844	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1845	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1846	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1847	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1848	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1849	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1850	    """
1851	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for Clip-Cov.
1852	
1853	    Adapted from
1854	    https://github.com/PRIME-RL/Entropy-Mechanism-of-RL/blob/main/verl/trainer/ppo/core_algos.py
1855	
1856	    Args:
1857	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1858	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1859	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1860	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1861	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1862	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1863	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1864	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1865	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1866	            Aggregation mode for `agg_loss`. Defaults to "token-mean".
1867	        kl_cov_ratio (float, optional):
1868	            Ratio for selecting the top-k covariance values. Defaults to 0.0002.
1869	        ppo_kl_coef (float, optional):
1870	            Coefficient for the KL penalty term in the loss. Defaults to 1.
1871	    """
1872	    assert config is not None
1873	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig), "passing AlgoConfig not supported yet"
1874	    assert config.policy_loss is not None
1875	
1876	    kl_cov_ratio = config.policy_loss.kl_cov_ratio if config.policy_loss.kl_cov_ratio is not None else 0.0002
1877	    ppo_kl_coef = config.policy_loss.ppo_kl_coef if config.policy_loss.ppo_kl_coef is not None else 1.0
1878	
1879	    assert kl_cov_ratio > 0, "kl_cov_ratio should be larger than 0."
1880	
1881	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1882	    abs_kl = negative_approx_kl.abs()
1883	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
1884	    ppo_kl_abs = verl_F.masked_mean(negative_approx_kl.abs(), response_mask)
1885	    pg_losses1 = -advantages * ratio
1886	    pg_losses_kl = -advantages * ratio + ppo_kl_coef * abs_kl
1887	    pg_losses = pg_losses1
1888	
1889	    all_valid = response_mask > 0
1890	    all_valid_idx = torch.nonzero(all_valid.reshape(-1), as_tuple=True)[0]
1891	    all_valid_adv = advantages[all_valid].detach().reshape(-1).cpu()
1892	    all_valid_logp = log_prob[all_valid].detach().reshape(-1).cpu()
1893	
1894	    k = min(kl_cov_ratio, len(all_valid_adv))
1895	
1896	    if k != 0:
1897	        cov_lst_all = (all_valid_adv - all_valid_adv.mean()) * (all_valid_logp - all_valid_logp.mean())
1898	        k_percent_nums = max(1, int(len(cov_lst_all) * kl_cov_ratio))
1899	        large_cov_idxs = torch.topk(cov_lst_all, k_percent_nums, largest=True).indices
1900	
1901	        if len(large_cov_idxs) != 0:
1902	            large_cov_idxs = all_valid_idx[large_cov_idxs]
1903	            pg_losses[large_cov_idxs // advantages.shape[1], large_cov_idxs % advantages.shape[1]] = pg_losses_kl[
1904	                large_cov_idxs // advantages.shape[1], large_cov_idxs % advantages.shape[1]
1905	            ]
1906	
1907	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1908	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1909	        pg_losses = pg_losses * rollout_is_weights
1910	
1911	    pg_loss = agg_loss(
1912	        loss_mat=pg_losses, loss_mask=response_mask, loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode, **config.global_batch_info
1913	    )
1914	    pg_metrics = {
1915	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl_abs.detach().item(),
1916	    }
1917	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics
1918

1920	@register_policy_loss("geo_mean")
1921	def compute_policy_loss_geo_mean(
1922	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1923	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
1924	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
1925	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
1926	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
1927	    config: Optional[ActorConfig] = None,
1928	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
1929	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
1930	    """
1931	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for GMPO.
1932	
1933	    Adapted from paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2507.20673
1934	    https://github.com/callsys/GMPO/blob/main/train_zero_math_gmpo.py
1935	
1936	    Args:
1937	        old_log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1938	            Log-probabilities of actions under the old policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1939	        log_prob (torch.Tensor):
1940	            Log-probabilities of actions under the current policy, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1941	        advantages (torch.Tensor):
1942	            Advantage estimates for each action, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1943	        response_mask (torch.Tensor):
1944	            Mask indicating which tokens to include in the loss, shape (batch_size, response_length).
1945	        loss_agg_mode (str, optional):
1946	            not used
1947	    """
1948	
1949	    assert config is not None
1950	    assert not isinstance(config, AlgoConfig)
1951	    clip_ratio = config.clip_ratio  # Clipping parameter. See https://arxiv.org/abs/1707.06347.
1952	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else clip_ratio
1953	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else clip_ratio
1954	
1955	    cliprange = clip_ratio
1956	    cliprange_low = clip_ratio_low
1957	    cliprange_high = clip_ratio_high
1958	    if cliprange_low is None:
1959	        cliprange_low = cliprange
1960	    if cliprange_high is None:
1961	        cliprange_high = cliprange
1962	
1963	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
1964	    # Clamp negative_approx_kl for stability (uncomment it if you like)
1965	    # negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
1966	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
1967	
1968	    # Clipping at token-level & Clipping wider
1969	    sgn_advantage = torch.sign(advantages)
1970	    negative_approx_kl_clamp = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, -cliprange_low, cliprange_high)
1971	    negative_approx_kl_min = torch.min(sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl, sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl_clamp)
1972	    negative_approx_kl_min = sgn_advantage * negative_approx_kl_min
1973	
1974	    # Geometric-Mean Policy Optimization
1975	    response_mask_sum = response_mask.sum(dim=-1)
1976	    ratio = torch.exp((negative_approx_kl_min * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8))
1977	    # we only support sequence level advantage for now,
1978	    # otherwise, below would be not consistent with the paper
1979	    advantage = (advantages * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8)
1980	    pg_losses = -advantage * ratio
1981	
1982	    # Apply rollout correction weights if provided
1983	    # For geo_mean, IS weights are 2D (batch_size, seq_length) and need to be aggregated to sequence level
1984	    if rollout_is_weights is not None:
1985	        # Aggregate token-level weights to sequence level using geometric mean for consistency
1986	        # Note: rollout_is_weights is always 2D regardless of aggregation mode
1987	        seq_is_weights = torch.exp(
1988	            (torch.log(rollout_is_weights + 1e-10) * response_mask).sum(dim=-1) / (response_mask_sum + 1e-8)
1989	        )
1990	        pg_losses = pg_losses * seq_is_weights
1991	
1992	    pg_loss = torch.mean(pg_losses)
1993	
1994	    # higher: ratio is too large that need clamp to clip_high (when adv > 0)
1995	    clipped = torch.ne(negative_approx_kl, negative_approx_kl_clamp)
1996	    pg_clipfrac = verl_F.masked_mean((clipped * (advantages > 0)).float(), response_mask)
1997	    pg_clipfrac_lower = verl_F.masked_mean((clipped * (advantages < 0)).float(), response_mask)
1998	    pg_metrics = {
1999	        "actor/pg_clipfrac": pg_clipfrac.detach().item(),
2000	        "actor/ppo_kl": ppo_kl.detach().item(),
2001	        "actor/pg_clipfrac_lower": pg_clipfrac_lower.detach().item(),
2002	    }
2003	    return pg_loss, pg_metrics
2004

2006	@register_policy_loss("cispo")
2007	def compute_policy_loss_cispo(
2008	    old_log_prob: torch.Tensor,
2009	    log_prob: torch.Tensor,
2010	    advantages: torch.Tensor,
2011	    response_mask: torch.Tensor,
2012	    loss_agg_mode: str = "token-mean",
2013	    config: Optional[DictConfig | ActorConfig] = None,
2014	    rollout_is_weights: torch.Tensor | None = None,
2015	) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, dict[str, Any]]:
2016	    """
2017	    Compute the clipped policy objective and related metrics for CISPO.
2018	
2019	    See https://arxiv.org/pdf/2506.13585 for more details.
2020	    """
2021	
2022	    assert config is not None
2023	    assert isinstance(config, ActorConfig)
2024	    clip_ratio_low = config.clip_ratio_low if config.clip_ratio_low is not None else config.clip_ratio
2025	    clip_ratio_high = config.clip_ratio_high if config.clip_ratio_high is not None else config.clip_ratio
2026	
2027	    # Compute importance sampling ratio: π_θ / π_θ_old
2028	    negative_approx_kl = log_prob - old_log_prob
2029	    # Clamp for numerical stability
2030	    negative_approx_kl = torch.clamp(negative_approx_kl, min=-20.0, max=20.0)
2031	    ratio = torch.exp(negative_approx_kl)
2032	    ppo_kl = verl_F.masked_mean(-negative_approx_kl, response_mask)
2033	
2034	    # CISPO: Clip the importance sampling weights
2035	    # KEY: Apply stop gradient to the clipped ratio
2036	    # This prevents gradients from flowing through the ratio computation and clipping
2037	    # Gradients only flow through log_prob in the final loss term
2038	    clipped_ratio = torch.clamp(ratio, 1 - clip_ratio_low, 1 + clip_ratio_high)
2039	    clipped_ratio_sg = clipped_ratio.detach()
